items.l1: A deeper contradiction is that if bio-based plastics are promoted on a large scale, they may give rise to new ecological ethics problems, such as competition with food for land and water resource consumption.
items.notes: Faithful; blind back landed almost verbatim on gold (only clause order and colon differ), so the low score is surface variation, not looseness.

items.l1: The rise of offshore wind farms further moved power generation equipment to continental shelf areas where the wind is steadier and stronger.
items.notes: Faithful; gold uses literary synonyms (更将, 装置, 迁移至) where back used 进一步, 设备, 推向, so several faithful renderings.

items.l1: Every day, the little bear plays together with its owner.
items.notes: Faithful and at the floor; only difference is the gold's possessive 它的 and fronted 每天, which the reference already carries.

items.l1: It is a way of treating guests.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's set phrase 待客之道 vs the plain 招待客人的方式 are both valid renderings of the same English.

items.l1: When drinking tea, people must be quiet and think good thoughts.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's 心里想好事 vs back's 想美好的事情 is a phrasing choice, the meaning is identical.

items.l1: In this way, everyone will feel it is very harmonious.
items.notes: Faithful; back differed only by 都 and a comma, so the low score comes from a very short sentence, not looseness.

items.l1: During flight, lift is not the only force acting on the aircraft.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's formal 并非唯一作用于 vs back's 并不是作用在…唯一的 is a register-neutral synonym swap.

items.l1: The aerodynamic challenges that an aircraft faces in different flight phases, such as takeoff, cruising and landing, differ, requiring the wing shape, such as the deployment of flaps and slats, to adapt dynamically.
items.notes: Faithful, with all three phases and both devices present; gold puts its examples in parentheses, which English renders as such-as clauses, so this is structural variation only.

items.l1: In the practical dimension of contemporary environmental ethics, the household composting system has become a micro-level carrier that embodies the concept of urban sustainability, not only reflecting an individual's active assumption of ecological responsibility, but also constituting an indispensable distributed node in the city's waste reduction strategy.
items.notes: Gold is mixed script, with Latin glosses (sustainability) and (waste reduction) inside the Chinese, which a learner can never reproduce; the reference itself is faithful and unchanged.

items.l1: The ideal ratio is about 1:2 by volume; this carbon-to-nitrogen ratio can promote the succession from mesophilic to thermophilic microbial communities, raising the pile to 55–65°C within a few days and effectively inactivating pathogens and weed seeds.
items.notes: Faithful and numbers match (1:2, 55–65°C); gold's parenthetical (体积比) and 嗜温/嗜热菌群 vs 中温/高温型 are alternate technical renderings.

items.l1: Special attention must be paid to strictly excluding animal-derived residues such as meat, fats and dairy products, because they easily cause anaerobic fermentation, breeding odors and pests.
items.notes: Faithful; gold restructures the sentence as a topic plus 应严格排除 with 因其/引致, while back kept the English verb-object order, so the content is the same.

items.l1: City apartments can use a sealed vermicomposter, using the gut microbes of red earthworms, Eisenia fetida, to efficiently break down finely chopped kitchen waste, producing a liquid humus concentrate rich in plant growth hormones, the "black gold".
items.notes: Gold is mixed script, with Latin (vermicomposter) and (Eisenia fetida) inside the Chinese; the reference also dropped 液, so the l1 here adds "liquid" to match 腐殖质浓缩液.

items.l1: Although this symbol originally served only a domestic American initiative, the high degree of abstraction in its form enabled it to cross national borders quickly.
items.notes: Faithful; back matched the gold clause for clause, and the low score reflects literary function words (该, 仅为, 形式上的…性) only.

items.l1: They talk and plan their actions.
items.notes: Loose: "moves" is game jargon that pulls toward 下一步/走法, while gold's generic 计划行动 means plan actions, so moves became actions.

items.l1: They help each other.
items.notes: Faithful; 帮助对方 and 互相帮助 are equally valid for "help each other", and no English wording separates them without distortion.

items.l1: At a gathering of friends, arriving one hour late is also fine.
items.notes: Faithful and "one hour" is kept; also fine maps to 也可以, and back's 也没关系 is a synonym.

items.l1: This is called time perception.
items.notes: The reference is exact (time perception = 时间感知); the low score came from the reviewer's drift to 时间观念, not from the reference.

items.l1: None of this is a problem.
items.notes: Loose in context: the same test already uses "fine" for 也可以, so "This is all fine" did not point to 没问题; the rewrite keeps the negative form and the all-scope.

items.l1: She spent a long time before she finished knitting this sweater.
items.notes: Faithful; 用了很久的时间…才把…织好 vs 花了很长时间才织完 are interchangeable renderings.

items.l1: At that time, I felt incredibly free and happy.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's literary topic 那时的我 has no natural English equivalent, and the meaning is identical.

items.l1: Money should also be divided fairly.
items.notes: Faithful; gold's colloquial complement 要分得公平 vs back's 应该公平分配 are both valid for "should be divided fairly".

items.l1: The world is changing, and we should be ready.
items.notes: Faithful and at the floor; 在变/要 vs 在变化/应该 are near-identical.

items.l1: This symbol means that things can be recycled and used again.
items.notes: Faithful; back only expanded 回收再用 and chose 的意思是 over 表示.

items.l1: We should cherish it.
items.notes: Faithful; 爱惜 and 珍惜 are both "cherish", and the score dropped because the sentence is three words long.

items.l1: The bear is very happy.
items.notes: The reference is exact; the reviewer added 小 from context and chose 开心 over 高兴, so the drift was the reviewer's, not the reference's.
